Biology 2016-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2016-I.question: Plants contain a variety of  sterols like stigmasterol, ergosterol, sitosterol etc. which very closely resemble cholesterol. These plant sterols are referred as:
Biology 2016-I.explanation: (a)  Phytosterols (plant sterols) are a family of molecules related to cholesterol. Structurally, these are very similar to cholesterol except that they always contain some substitutions at the C24 position on the sterol side chain.

Biology 2016-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2016-I.question: In artificial insemination (AI)  process. Which of the following is/are introduced into the uterus of the female ?
Biology 2016-I.explanation: (c)  The Artificial Insemination (AI) is the process in which a thin, flexible tube (Catheter) is used to put sperm artificially into a woman's cervix.

Biology 2016-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2016-I.question: Genetically modified (GM) crops contain modified genetic material due to :
Biology 2016-I.explanation: (d)  Introduction of new traits to the plant which does not occur naturally in the species introduction of new DNA and removal of existing DNA are the processes by which Genetically Modified crops are produced.

Biology 2016-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2016-I.question: Which one of the following vitamins  has a role in blood clotting ?
Biology 2016-I.explanation: (d)  Vitamin K is essential for the functioning of several proteins involved in physiological processes that encompass, but are not limited to, the regulation of blood clotting.

Biology 2016-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2016-I.question: Vitamin B12  deficiency causes pernicious anemia, Animals cannot synthesize vitamin B12. Humans must obtain all their vitamin B12 from their diet. The complexing metal ion in vitamin B12 is  :
Biology 2016-I.explanation: (c)  Cobalt is the active centre of coenzymes called cobalamins, the most common example of which is vitamin B12.

Biology 2016-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2016-I.question: Glucose is a source of energy. Which one of the following types of  molecule is glucose ?
Biology 2016-I.explanation: (a)  Glucose is a sugar with the molecular formula C6H12O6. The suffix "-ose" is a chemical classifier, denoting a Carbohydrate.

Biology 2016-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2016-I.question: The living content of cell is called protoplasm. It is composed of :
Biology 2016-I.explanation: (d)  Protoplasm is the whole content of a cell enclosed within the cell membrane, including both the cytoplasm and nucleus.

Biology 2016-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2016-I.question: Which one of the following hormones contains peptide chain ?
Biology 2016-I.explanation: (c)  Insulin is a peptide hormone produced by beta cells in the pancreas and by Brockmann body in some teleost fish.

Biology 2016-I.question: Which one of the following is considered as 'good cholesterol' with reference to individuals facing the risk of cardio-vascular diseases and hypertension?
Biology 2016-I.explanation: (a)  Good Cholesterol refers to HDL (High Density Lipoprotein), Lipoproteins are complex particles composed of multiple type of proteins.

Biology 2016-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2016-I.question: The Germplasm is required for the propagation of plants and animals, Germplasm is the :
Biology 2016-I.explanation: (b)  Germplasm is a biosubstance (eg. - seeds, tissue pollen grains, sperms & eggs etc.) which is used as genetic material for animal & plant breeding for preservation and research purpose.

Biology 2016-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2016-I.question: Dengue virus is known to cause low platelet count in blood of patient by :
Biology 2016-I.explanation: (d)  Dengue virus after infection, interferes the production of platelets in bone marrow, infects endothelial cells and bind with platelets.
